 How to Watch Hawks vs Hornets
 When: Friday, October 23, 2026
 Time: 7:00 PM ET
 TV Channel: ABC 9, ANF – Atlanta News First
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Atlanta enters Friday's matchup following a 132-125 victory over the Orlando Magic in Wednesday's season opener. Nickeil Alexander-Walker led the Hawks with 31 points, connecting on five three-pointers, including two big shots in the final minutes. Jalen Johnson contributed 20 points and 14 rebounds, while Dyson Daniels added 20 points and five steals. CJ McCollum chipped in 19 points as Atlanta overcame an early double-digit deficit and outscored Orlando 33-25 in the fourth quarter to earn its first victory of the season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Charlotte also opened its season with a win, defeating the Brooklyn Nets 110-103 on Wednesday. Grayson Allen paced the Hornets with 21 points off the bench, knocking down five three-pointers, while Naz Reid delivered 20 points, 11 rebounds and seven assists in his Charlotte debut. Dennis Schroder contributed 19 points and six assists, and Brandon Miller added 18 points. The Hornets outrebounded Brooklyn 43-38 and racked up 20 second-chance points, using their advantage on the glass and balanced offense to defeat the Nets.
